feature_title: SLO PromQL Time-Slice Support and Validation

rationale.edition: All 41 changed files live under OSS paths: src/config/, src/core/, src/infra/, web/src/, tests/ui-testing/, and scripts/translations/. No enterprise-owned directories (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/) appear in the changed_files.txt list. No enterprise-gated keywords (cipher, SSO, SAML, RBAC, SDR, logo-management) appear in the changed paths or symbol names — SLO is a shared OSS feature.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The change is user-facing: it touches web/src/components/slos/ (Vue components), web/src/views/slos/AddSlo.vue (SLO creation view), and web/src/utils/slos/ (query utilities). No explicit opt-out label or skip comment was provided in trigger_comment.txt. The diff is not docs-only, CI-only, or comment/test-data-only.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The diff adds and modifies multiple user-facing Vue components implementing SLO creation workflows: a new alert-condition editor (SloAlertCondition), expression field with language switching (SloExpressionField), PromQL-based preview chart (SloPreviewChart), time-slice preview panel (SloTimeSlicePreview), and the main AddSlo view. New validation rules (scope rejection for PromQL, empty-aggregate rejection, SQL-over-metrics) and a new time-slice PromQL query language option all involve interactive form flows a user must navigate.
rationale.area: Alerts — the closest existing test area in the ci_matrix. SLOs are managed alongside alerts in the OpenObserve UI (the SLO detail view includes an alerts tab, and SLO alert conditions are part of this diff). There is no dedicated 'Slos' test folder; the Alerts shard is the most natural home for SLO-focused E2E specs until a dedicated area is created.
rationale.group: Alerts — the existing playwright_group in ci_matrix_env.json and ci_matrix.ent.json whose run_files include alert workflow specs (alerts-e2e-flow.spec.js, alerts-ui-operations.spec.js). An SLO validation spec fits naturally alongside these because SLO creation and alert-condition editing are part of the same user journey.
rationale.existing_tests: One Playwright E2E spec is in the diff: tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Logs/searchPatterns.spec.js. It is unrelated to the SLO feature — it covers Logs search patterns — so it does not provide coverage for the new SLO validation/creation flows. The many Vitest unit specs (web/src/**/*.spec.ts) are unit tests, not E2E coverage, and the Rust tests in src/config/ are backend-only.
